title: fix(plugin-auth): the Magic Link mail states the lifetime the link really has, five minutes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25112

Clause-②: no

Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The `auth.magic_link` mail said "This link expires in 10 minutes" while the link it carries lived 300 s: `magicLink()` was mounted without `expiresIn` (so better-auth's own default applied) and `sendMagicLink` passed a separate hard-coded `expiresInMinutes: 10`.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`: one local constant, `magicLinkExpiresInSec = 5 * 60`, beside the mount. The mount now passes `expiresIn: magicLinkExpiresInSec`, and the mail's `expiresInMinutes` is `Math.round(magicLinkExpiresInSec / 60)`. The copy and the link read one source.
- The link's **lifetime does not change**. It was 300 s, measured in the installed better-auth 1.7.12 (`dist/plugins/magic-link/index.mjs`, `expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (opts.expiresIn || 300) * 1e3)`), and it stays 300 s, now stated rather than inherited, so a dependency bump cannot move it under the mail.
- The seat's ruling on the card's open value (claim comment 6341542393), executed as written: keep the measured 300 s, state it from one constant, derive the mail from it. Lengthening the lifetime would relax a sign-in credential and stays with the maintainer.

## Where the fix lives, and why not in plugin-email

All four locale rows of `auth.magic_link` in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts` (en-US, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES), HTML and text faces, render the lifetime only from `{{expiresInMinutes}}`. None hard-codes a number. The false value was produced entirely by the producer in plugin-auth, so plugin-email does not move and takes no changeset.

## Tests

- `auth-email-locale.test.ts`: the existing payload pin asserted the false `10`; it now asserts `5`. A new pin asserts the mount states `expiresIn: 300` and that the mail's `expiresInMinutes * 60` equals the mount's `expiresIn`.
- Ablation, on head `145974256` with the fix committed first, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1, then 0; blob restored to the HEAD blob `c3dd34d7bf34` both times):
  1. `expiresInMinutes` set back to the literal `10`: 2 failed / 67 passed (`expected 10 to be 5`, `expected 600 to be 300`).
  2. `expiresIn` deleted from the mount: 1 failed / 68 passed (`expected undefined to be 300`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build && typecheck && test`: 185 files passed, 3487 passed and 10 skipped.

## Gates

`dispatch-gates --commands` derived 70 commands for this diff, and all 70 exited 0. Reconciliation: `70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Two of them first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow clone, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` without a full build. Both were re-run after `git fetch --unshallow` and `pnpm build`, and both exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `plugin-email`'s template tests feed `auth.magic_link` the sample value `expiresInMinutes: 10` (`plain-text-faces.test.ts`, `auth-templates-locales.test.ts`). It is only render data and makes no claim about the link's lifetime, so it is left as is.
- `check:auth-mount-ledger` tracks route mounts, not plugin options, so it does not read this change.
